component_checklist.assertion: On first open, when no registered model matches, the weight-source dialog shows the localized choose-where sentence, one outlined select, and one empty combobox named by the localized choose-a-source sentence. The combobox is not marked required and has no maximum length. The register-and-deploy button stays disabled. There is no spinbutton, no unit, no checkbox, no radio, and no alert. The outlined select lists Hugging Face and ModelScope, each joined to the fixture repository. After ModelScope is selected, the successful create POST to /api/v1/models/quick-register sends source modelscope, the fixture repository, revision main, the repository as the name, the fixture weight in bytes, quantization fp16, architecture Qwen2ForCausalLM, and context length 4096, and the response is 201. The independent GET stores source modelscope, the fixture repository, revision master, that name, architecture Qwen2ForCausalLM, precision float16, context length 4096, the fixture readme, and the fixture weight, with no node copy and no storage copy.
